t: Core Glossary: Multimeters — Signature Edition — Signature Method
title: Core Glossary: Multimeters — Signature Edition — Signature Method
description: Core Glossary: Multimeters — Signature Edition — Signature Method: the working vocabulary of Multimeters — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. The Signature edition: the JAH system's original reference on Multimeters. Multimeters diagnose circuits: voltage, current, resistance, continuity. CAT ratings are safety — match the panel you're probing.
definition: Core Glossary: Multimeters — Signature Edition — Signature Method — the working vocabulary of Multimeters — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Accuracy: How close readings are to the true value.
Precision: How repeatable readings are, regardless of truth.
Resolution: The smallest change an instrument can display.
Calibration: Checking a measuring tool against a known standard.
Zero error: The reading shown with no input applied; subtract it out.
Parallax: Reading error from viewing a scale at an angle.
Tolerance: The allowed variation from a stated dimension.
Traceability: The unbroken chain from your reading to a national standard.
Uncertainty: The quantified doubt around any measurement.
Datum: The reference surface or point measurements start from.
